## Overview {#overview}

The lantern keeps its flame behind thin glass so the wind cannot reach it.

A keeper trims the wick every evening before the fishing boats come home.

## Fuel {#fuel}

Whale oil burned bright but smelled of the sea and cost a fortune.

Kerosene replaced it after 1860 because it was cheaper to refine.

## Lenses {#lenses}

A Fresnel lens bends the light into a single horizontal beam.

## Keepers {#keepers}

The last keeper left the island in 1962.

The light still turns every night.
